description: Run a type keyboard command on text: step size, leading, kerning/tracking, baseline shift or scale; auto leading; reset kerning and tracking or scale; bold, italic, normal; toggle all caps, small caps, superscript, subscript, ligatures, No Break; paragraph alignment (incl. towards/away from spine); toggle align to baseline grid, hyphenation, Ignore Optical Margin; choose or switch composer (Paragraph, Single-line, World-Ready); paragraph direction; reset indents

amount.description: Step for increase/decrease commands: points for size, leading and baseline shift (default 2), thousandths of an em for kerning/tracking (default 20), percent for scale (default 5)

command.description: The command. Toggles read the first character and set every chosen character the same way; steps apply run by run

text.description: Which text to act on. Give text frame ids, story ids, or selection: true; optionally narrow each to a character range (start/end) or a paragraph range (paragraphs)

end.description: Last character, inclusive (default: the end of the text)

ids.description: Text frame ids (PageItem.id); acts on the text in each frame, or its whole story with wholeStory

paragraphs.description: [first, last] paragraph indexes (0-based, inclusive) within each chosen text

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

start.description: First character (0-based, within each chosen text)

wholeStory.description: For frames and selected text, act on the whole story they belong to

name: apply_type_command
title: Apply Type Command
